name: Usotsuki Mono ga Doku o Kurau Hi
original_name: 嘘つきものが毒を喰らう日
source:
"Hey, liar. Talk to me,"

The man who stole my precious thing grinned and said.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6681]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“喂，骗子，来陪我聊聊天吧。”

偷走我心爱之物的那个男人，咧嘴一笑，这样说道。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6681]NovelGame[/url]]
